title: Pop Pop Wash Your Hands | Fun Hand Washing Song for Kids | BuBu TV - English
description:
A fun, bouncy song that teaches little ones why washing hands with soap and bubbles keeps germs away.
Little sister learns that clean hands are the best hands, even when a tasty treat is nearby!
Sing along and make handwashing a happy habit every day.

Little sister's hands are muddy, muddy
Oh, what a messy sight!
Grab, grab, grab a pani puri
Yum, yum, yum, so tasty!

Pop pop, wash your hands
Bubbles make them clean
Swish, swish, swish, swish
Shiny, shiny, clean!

The puri jumps away, away
Not for those dirty hands
Hop, hop, hop, hop
Oops, the puri runs!

Pop pop, wash your hands
Bubbles make them clean
Swish, swish, swish, swish
Shiny, shiny, clean!

Here comes the big rainbow bubble
Floating, floating high
Bye, bye, bye germs, bye bye
Pop goes the germs, goodbye!

Pop pop, wash your hands
Bubbles make them clean
Swish, swish, swish, swish
Shiny, shiny, clean!

Clean hands, clean hands, look at them
The puri says "come here!"
Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch
Yum, yum, sweet and near!
